title: ABPI and Blood Glucose — Two Checks That Make Exercise Safer

hook.en: A patient with leg pain on walking and a patient with diabetes starting a new programme both need a number before exercise. Learn how to measure the ankle-brachial pressure index and read a finger-prick glucose.
hook.ur: Chalte hue taang ke dard wale patient aur nayi programme shuru karne wale diabetic patient dono ko exercise se pehle ek number chahiye. Ankle-brachial pressure index naapna aur finger-prick glucose parhna seekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll measure and calculate an ABPI, interpret it, take a capillary glucose correctly and know the glucose limits for starting exercise.
goal.ur: End tak aap ABPI naapenge aur calculate karenge, usay interpret karenge, capillary glucose sahi lenge aur exercise shuru karne ke glucose limits jaanenge.

text.en: The **ankle-brachial pressure index (ABPI)** compares the blood pressure at the ankle with the pressure in the arm: **ABPI = ankle systolic ÷ the higher arm systolic**. **1.0–1.3 is normal; below 0.9 suggests peripheral arterial disease; above 1.3 means stiff, calcified vessels (common in diabetes), so the number is unreliable.** A **finger-prick glucose** gives the blood sugar right now: fasting about **4–7 mmol/L (72–126 mg/dL)**; below 4 mmol/L (70 mg/dL) or above about 15 mmol/L (270 mg/dL) means act before exercise.
text.ur: **Ankle-brachial pressure index (ABPI)** ankle ke blood pressure ko arm ke pressure se compare karta hai: **ABPI = ankle systolic ÷ arm ka zyada systolic**. **1.0–1.3 normal; 0.9 se kam peripheral arterial disease batata hai; 1.3 se zyada ka matlab sakht, calcified vessels (diabetes mein aam), is liye number ghair-bharosay ka.** **Finger-prick glucose** abhi ka blood sugar batata hai: fasting takriban **4–7 mmol/L (72–126 mg/dL)**; 4 mmol/L (70 mg/dL) se neeche ya takriban 15 mmol/L (270 mg/dL) se upar ka matlab exercise se pehle action lein.

text.en: ABPI is a pressure check on a water main. Compare the pressure at the end of the pipe (the ankle) with the pressure at the source (the arm). If the end pressure is much lower, there is a blockage in between. If the pipe walls are too stiff to squash, the gauge reads falsely high.
text.ur: ABPI paani ki main pipe ka pressure check hai. Pipe ke sirey (ankle) ke pressure ko source (arm) ke pressure se compare karein. Sirey ka pressure bohat kam ho to beech mein rukawat hai. Pipe ki deewarein itni sakht hon ke dab na saken to gauge jhooti zyada parhta hai.

intro.en: The patient lies supine and rested for 10 minutes. The cuff goes above the ankle, the Doppler probe on the dorsalis pedis pulse; inflate until the signal stops, then deflate slowly: the pressure when the signal returns is the **ankle systolic pressure**. Divide by the higher arm pressure. Here 118 ÷ 130 gives an ABPI of about 0.9.
intro.ur: Patient supine aur 10 minute rested. Cuff ankle ke upar, Doppler probe dorsalis pedis pulse par; signal band hone tak inflate karein, phir aahista deflate: jis pressure par signal wapas aaye woh **ankle systolic pressure** hai. Arm ke zyada pressure se taqseem karein. Yahan 118 ÷ 130 takriban 0.9 ABPI deta hai.

question.en: The ankle systolic pressure is 90 mmHg and the higher arm pressure is 150 mmHg. What is the ABPI and its meaning?
question.ur: Ankle systolic pressure 90 mmHg aur arm ka zyada pressure 150 mmHg hai. ABPI aur uska matlab kya hai?

feedback.en: Yes — 90 ÷ 150 = 0.6. Below 0.9 suggests arterial disease; roughly 0.5–0.9 is mild to moderate and below about 0.4 is severe.
feedback.ur: Haan — 90 ÷ 150 = 0.6. 0.9 se kam arterial disease batata hai; takriban 0.5–0.9 halki se moderate aur 0.4 se kam shadeed.

feedback.en: You divided the wrong way round; ankle goes over arm.
feedback.ur: Aap ne ulta taqseem kiya; ankle ko arm par taqseem karte hain.

feedback.en: The result is 0.6, and 0.9 would already be the borderline.
feedback.ur: Result 0.6 hai, aur 0.9 pehle hi hadd par hota.

intro.en: Wash and dry the hands, load a new strip and lancet, prick the **side of a fingertip** (not the pad) and touch the drop to the strip. Read the meter and record the value and the time of the last meal. A reading outside the safe range for exercise needs action.
intro.ur: Haath dho kar sukha lein, nayi strip aur lancet load karein, **fingertip ki side** par prick karein (pad par nahi) aur boond ko strip se lagayein. Meter parhein aur value aur aakhri khane ka waqt likhein. Exercise ke mehfooz range se bahar reading par action chahiye.

title.en: Glucose and exercise — what to do
title.ur: Glucose aur exercise — kya karna hai

rows.en: Take 15–20 g fast carbohydrate, recheck in 15 minutes; do not exercise until it is above 5 mmol/L and stable
rows.ur: 15–20 g fast carbohydrate lein, 15 minute baad dobara check karein; 5 mmol/L se upar aur stable hone tak exercise na karein

rows.en: Low normal, especially on insulin or sulfonylureas
rows.ur: Kam normal, khaas taur par insulin ya sulfonylureas par

rows.en: Take a snack of carbohydrate (about 10–20 g) before starting
rows.ur: Shuru karne se pehle carbohydrate ka snack (takriban 10–20 g) lein

rows.en: Go ahead; keep fluids and glucose available
rows.ur: Aage barhein; paani aur glucose paas rakhein
Hyperglycaemia; type 1 mein ketones check karein

rows.en: Do not start if unwell or ketones are present; drink water and recheck
rows.ur: Bimar ho ya ketones hon to shuru na karein; paani piyein aur dobara check karein

text.en: **ABPI errors and glucose traps.** In diabetes and kidney disease the arteries can be calcified and incompressible, so the ankle pressure reads falsely high and a **normal or high ABPI hides disease**; use the toe-brachial index instead. For the ABPI, measuring after exercise or with the patient not rested lowers the ankle pressure; use the **higher of the two arm pressures**. For glucose, a wet or dirty fingertip, a too-small blood drop or an expired strip give wrong numbers, and testing right after eating sugar over-reads.
text.ur: **ABPI ki ghaltiyan aur glucose ke jaal.** Diabetes aur kidney disease mein arteries calcified aur na-dabne wali ho sakti hain, is liye ankle pressure jhoota zyada parhta hai aur **normal ya zyada ABPI bimari chhupa leta hai**; iske bajaye toe-brachial index use karein. ABPI ke liye exercise ke baad ya bina rest ke naapne se ankle pressure kam aata hai; **dono arm pressures mein se zyada wala** lein. Glucose ke liye geeli ya gandi fingertip, bohat chhoti boond ya expire strip ghalat numbers deti hain, aur chini khane ke foran baad test karne se zyada reading aati hai.

question.en: A long-standing diabetic man has an ABPI of 1.4 and cramping calf pain on walking. How do you interpret this?
question.ur: Purane diabetic aadmi ka ABPI 1.4 hai aur chalne par pindli mein khinchao ka dard hai. Isay kaise interpret karein?

text.en: The vessels may be stiff and calcified, so the ABPI is unreliable; request a toe-brachial index or vascular assessment
text.ur: Vessels sakht aur calcified ho sakte hain, is liye ABPI ghair-bharosay ka hai; toe-brachial index ya vascular assessment manga lein

feedback.en: Yes — an ABPI above 1.3 suggests non-compressible vessels, and claudication symptoms still need investigation.
feedback.ur: Haan — 1.3 se zyada ABPI non-compressible vessels batata hai, aur claudication ke symptoms ki phir bhi tafteesh zaroori hai.

text.en: It is normal, so there is no arterial problem
text.ur: Yeh normal hai, is liye arterial masla nahi

feedback.en: A falsely high value does not exclude disease.
feedback.ur: Jhoothi zyada value bimari ko rule out nahi karti.

text.ur: Yeh shadeed arterial disease dikhata hai

feedback.en: A high ABPI does not indicate severe disease; it indicates unreliable compression.
feedback.ur: Zyada ABPI shadeed bimari nahi, ghair-bharosay ka compression batata hai.

text.en: **From the number to the plan.** An ABPI of 0.5–0.9 with walking-induced calf pain (claudication) is a strong indication for **supervised walking exercise** (walk to moderate-to-severe pain, rest, repeat, for at least 30–60 minutes three times a week), risk-factor control and smoking cessation. An ABPI below about 0.4, rest pain, tissue loss or a cold pale foot is **critical limb ischaemia**: urgent vascular referral, no exercise. For diabetes, know the patient's medicines and plan the session when glucose is likely to be stable (not at peak insulin), carry fast sugar and test before and after.
text.ur: **Number se plan tak.** 0.5–0.9 ABPI aur chalne se hone wala pindli ka dard (claudication) **supervised walking exercise** (moderate se shadeed dard tak chalein, rest karein, dohrayein, kam az kam 30–60 minute, hafte mein teen baar), risk-factor control aur cigarette chhorne ka mazboot ishara hai. 0.4 se kam ABPI, aaraam ka dard, tissue loss ya thanda peela foot **critical limb ischaemia** hai: urgent vascular referral, exercise nahi. Diabetes mein patient ki dawaiyan jaanein aur session aise waqt rakhein jab glucose stable ho (insulin ke peak par nahi), fast sugar saath rakhein aur pehle aur baad mein test karein.

text.en: Supervised exercise therapy for intermittent claudication improves **maximal walking distance by about 100–200 m or more** and is recommended as first-line treatment (Cochrane review; ESC and AHA guidelines). A resting ABPI below 0.9 has about 75% sensitivity and over 90% specificity for arterial disease in people without diabetes; in diabetes the sensitivity falls because of vessel stiffness. For diabetes, regular exercise lowers HbA1c by about 0.5–0.7 percentage points.
text.ur: Intermittent claudication ke liye supervised exercise therapy **maximal walking distance ko takriban 100–200 m ya zyada** behtar karti hai aur first-line ilaaj ke taur par sifarish ki jati hai (Cochrane review; ESC aur AHA guidelines). Aaraam ka ABPI 0.9 se kam diabetes ke bagair logon mein arterial disease ke liye takriban 75 % sensitivity aur 90 % se zyada specificity rakhta hai; diabetes mein vessel ki sakhti ki wajah se sensitivity kam ho jati hai. Diabetes mein baqaida exercise HbA1c ko takriban 0.5–0.7 percentage points kam karti hai.

question.en: Why can exercise cause hypoglycaemia in a person taking insulin hours after the session?
question.ur: Insulin lene wale shakhs mein session ke ghanton baad bhi exercise hypoglycaemia kyun kar sakti hai?

answer.en: Because exercise makes muscles take up glucose and raises insulin sensitivity for up to 24 hours as muscle glycogen is replenished, so a "normal" dose of insulin can drop the sugar late (delayed hypoglycaemia), especially after long or intense sessions or at night. Monitor after exercise and discuss dose changes with the diabetes team.
answer.ur: Kyunke exercise muscles ko glucose jazb karwati hai aur insulin sensitivity ko 24 ghanton tak barhati hai jab tak muscle glycogen dobara bharta hai, is liye insulin ki “normal” dose sugar ko der se gira sakti hai (delayed hypoglycaemia), khaas taur par lambay ya shadeed sessions ke baad ya raat ko. Exercise ke baad monitor karein aur dose ki tabdeeli diabetes team se discuss karein.

question.en: A patient on insulin has a glucose of 3.6 mmol/L before a session. What do you do?
question.ur: Insulin lene wale patient ka session se pehle glucose 3.6 mmol/L hai. Kya karein?

text.en: Treat the low first with fast carbohydrate, recheck after 15 minutes and delay exercise until it is stable and above about 5 mmol/L
text.ur: Pehle fast carbohydrate se ilaaj karein, 15 minute baad dobara check karein aur jab tak stable aur takriban 5 mmol/L se upar na ho exercise rok dein

feedback.en: Yes — exercising with hypoglycaemia is dangerous and can cause collapse.
feedback.ur: Haan — hypoglycaemia mein exercise khatarnak hai aur behoshi kar sakti hai.

text.en: Start with a gentle warm-up to raise it
text.ur: Barhane ke liye halki warm-up se shuru karein

feedback.ur: Exercise glucose ko mazeed kam karti hai.

text.en: Ignore it because the patient feels fine
text.ur: Nazar-andaz karein kyunke patient theek mehsoos karta hai

feedback.en: A low reading can come without warning symptoms.
feedback.ur: Kam reading bina warning symptoms ke bhi aa sakti hai.

text.en: **Emergency:** a person who is confused, sweating, shaking, drowsy or unconscious with diabetes may have severe hypoglycaemia: give fast sugar if they can swallow safely, otherwise call an ambulance; do not put food in an unconscious mouth. Rest pain in the foot, a cold pale foot with absent pulses, or a new ulcer or black toe needs **same-day vascular review**. Do not exercise a limb with critical ischaemia.
text.ur: **Emergency:** diabetes ka confused, paseenay mein, kaanpta, ghunoodgi ya behoshi wala shakhs shadeed hypoglycaemia mein ho sakta hai: nigalne mein mehfooz ho to fast sugar dein, warna ambulance bulayein; behosh shakhs ke munh mein khana na daalein. Foot mein aaraam ka dard, thanda peela foot jis mein pulses na hon, ya naya ulcer ya kaala angootha **usi din vascular review** chahta hai. Critical ischaemia wali limb ko exercise na karwayein.

summary.en: ABPI = ankle systolic ÷ higher arm systolic: 1.0–1.3 normal, below 0.9 arterial disease, above 1.3 stiff vessels (unreliable).
summary.ur: ABPI = ankle systolic ÷ arm ka zyada systolic: 1.0–1.3 normal, 0.9 se kam arterial disease, 1.3 se zyada sakht vessels (ghair-bharosay ka).

summary.en: Finger-prick glucose for exercise: below 4 mmol/L treat first, 5.6–13.9 acceptable, above about 15 mmol/L check ketones and do not start if unwell.
summary.ur: Exercise ke liye finger-prick glucose: 4 mmol/L se neeche pehle ilaaj, 5.6–13.9 qabil-e-qabool, takriban 15 mmol/L se upar ketones check karein aur bimar ho to shuru na karein.

summary.en: Claudication with a low ABPI benefits from supervised walking; rest pain, tissue loss or a cold foot is an emergency.
summary.ur: Kam ABPI ke saath claudication supervised walking se behtar hoti hai; aaraam ka dard, tissue loss ya thanda foot emergency hai.

front.en: How is the ABPI calculated and what are the cut-offs?
front.ur: ABPI kaise calculate hota hai aur cut-offs kya hain?

back.en: Ankle systolic ÷ higher arm systolic; 1.0–1.3 normal, below 0.9 disease, above 1.3 stiff vessels.
back.ur: Ankle systolic ÷ arm ka zyada systolic; 1.0–1.3 normal, 0.9 se kam bimari, 1.3 se zyada sakht vessels.

front.en: Where do you prick for a glucose reading?
front.ur: Glucose ke liye kahan prick karte hain?

back.en: The side of a fingertip, not the pad.

front.en: Safe glucose range to start exercise?
front.ur: Exercise shuru karne ke liye mehfooz glucose range?

back.en: About 5.6–13.9 mmol/L (100–250 mg/dL); below 4 treat first; above about 15 check ketones.
back.ur: Takriban 5.6–13.9 mmol/L (100–250 mg/dL); 4 se kam pehle ilaaj; takriban 15 se upar ketones check karein.

back.en: Supervised walking to moderate-to-severe calf pain, rest, repeat; at least 30–60 minutes three times weekly.
back.ur: Moderate se shadeed pindli ke dard tak supervised walking, rest, dohrayein; kam az kam 30–60 minute hafte mein teen baar.
